I’m currently revisiting deep learning, and I’ve decided to build a small course alongside it.

The course is hosted on my GitHub repository: [mini-course-DL](https://github.com/AdamArras/mini-course-DL)

You can also run the notebooks directly in your browser using **Google Colab**, without installing anything. The first lesson is available here:  

- [lesson 1](https://colab.research.google.com/github/AdamArras/mini-course-DL/blob/main/notebooks/lesson1_fr.ipynb) (in french)

- [lesson 2](https://colab.research.google.com/github/AdamArras/mini-course-DL/blob/main/notebooks/lesson2.ipynb) and [solution](https://colab.research.google.com/github/AdamArras/mini-course-DL/blob/main/notebooks/lesson2_solution.ipynb)

More content will be added as the course grows.
